# Funok Water and Engineering Services Limited

> Nigerian water engineering firm based in Enugu with more than 30 years of experience in borehole drilling, ground and surface water exploration, irrigation and dams, water supply engineering, and water resources consultancy. More than 200 projects completed across 12+ Nigerian states.

Funok Water and Engineering Services Limited is registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) under the Companies and Allied Matters Act 1990, Federal Republic of Nigeria. Motto: "Construction tomorrow for today".

## Services

- Borehole Drilling: professional borehole drilling, casing and development for communities, industries and individuals across Nigeria.
- Surface Water Exploration: surface and ground water exploration using modern hydrogeological techniques.
- Irrigation & Dams: design and construction of irrigation systems and dams for agriculture and water storage.
- Engineering Services: water supply system design and infrastructure development.
- Consultancy: water resources management, feasibility studies and environmental assessments.
- General Contracting: general contractors and suppliers for civil and water engineering projects of any scale.
- Water Management: water resource management aligned with Nigerian and global best practices.

## Partners

- WaterAid
- Agence Française de Développement (AFD)
- Seureca Veolia
- UNICEF

## Values

Integrity, Respect for People, Value for Investment, Excellence, Transparency.
